description: High-resolution traffic flow data from the urban traffic control system in Glasgow is a data set deposited in University of Glasgow by its authors Urban Big Data Centre. This dataset offers a long-term traffic flow data at an intra-city scale with high spatio-temporal granularity. The dataset covers the Glasgow City Council area for four consecutive years spanning the COVID-19 pandemic, from October 2019 to September 2023, providing temporal and spatial coverage. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: XML, ZIP, Excel. Size stated: 54325 KB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
